entities.name: Extus Narr
entities.description: A human warlock and head of the Oriq who lurked in the shadows of Strixhaven.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university Extus attended and attacked.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: The group Extus took control of.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: The five dragons who passed Extus over for the role of Oracle.

entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: A being of war and destruction that Extus summoned and that killed him.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A planeswalker brought to Extus who helped the Oriq.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: Distracted by Lukka during the assault.

entities.name: Strixhaven Snarl
entities.description: A maelstrom of power left from the creation of the world.

entities.name: Professor Onyx
entities.description: Professor who tried to intervene and was translocated away.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: One of the twins who tried to intervene.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: One of the twins who tried to intervene.

events.summary: Extus is passed over for the role of Oracle by the Founder Dragons.
events.quote: he was passed over for the role of Oracle by the five Founder Dragons

events.summary: Extus takes control of the Oriq and seeks vengeance, trying to awaken the Blood Avatar.
events.quote: he took control of the Oriq and began his path for vengeance

events.summary: Lukka helps the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating a mage hunter attack on Strixhaven.
events.quote: Lukka helped the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating a mage hunter attack on Strixhaven.

events.summary: During the chaos, Extus descends into the Hall of Oracles to harness the Snarl.
events.quote: Extus entered the Biblioplex and descended into the Hall of Oracles

events.summary: Onyx is translocated away and the Kenrith twins are kept at bay.
events.quote: the professor was translocated away while the twins were easily kept at bay

events.summary: Extus summons the Blood Avatar and is killed by it.
events.quote: he was killed in the fight by the very creature he had summoned

relations.quote: was the head of the Oriq
he was killed in the fight by the very creature he had summoned
He had a special hatred for the Dragonsguard
